Because each Soyuz-TMA spacecraft could hold only three people, two separate launches were necessary: Soyuz TMA-14 launched on 26 March 2009, and Soyuz TMA-15 followed on 27 May 2009.

Expedition 25 | Expedition 25 was the 25th long-duration mission to the International Space Station (ISS).  Expedition 25 began with the Soyuz TMA-18 undocking on 25 September 2010.
